mostWorthwhile.text: Building the capillary bed was most worthwhile because its thin walls were explicitly linked to exchange between blood and the fluid around cells.

leastWorthwhile.text: Branching the artery and then joining it to the capillary bed felt repetitive: both results were predictable and offered little explanation beyond their pictures.

surprise.text: The final explanation clarified the valves' role in preventing backward flow; their earlier picture showed their placement but did not explain their function.

arbitrary.text: None of the combinations felt purposeless, although several were the only offered action and left little room for a meaningful decision.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in continuing to see how the vessel network connects to other body systems, though the predictable sequence makes me uncertain how engaging another chapter would be.
